column1: # clues_empty_fields.tsv for ex00_ft_split_empty_fields_output (strict) -- a READING's own hint.
# Format: <hint><TAB><member CASE label><TAB>...   (fires if ANY member case fails)

ft_split's box (p.11) does not say what a field with no byte in it gives. This harness's reading, at strict and never the subject's: no string -- so delimiters at either end or side by side add nothing, "" and a string of delimiters give an array holding only its NULL, and c == '\0' finds no delimiter in s. Where in your function could a field with no byte become a string, and what does your array hold when s has no word at all?
